description: This file defines a benchmarking class for measuring communication latency and throughput between grains in an Orleans-based distributed system using BenchmarkDotNet. It sets up multiple silos and clients, and provides methods to run various ping-pong load tests, including continuous and concurrent pings.

classes.name: PingBenchmark
classes.description: A class that benchmarks the latency and throughput of grain-to-grain communication in Orleans using various load patterns.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Benchmark method that performs a single ping operation.

methods.name: PingForever
methods.description: Performs continuous ping operations to measure latency.

methods.name: PingConcurrent
methods.description: Performs a fixed number of concurrent ping operations.

methods.name: PingConcurrentHostedClient
methods.description: Performs concurrent ping operations with a hosted client.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Runs a load generator that issues a specified number of requests to grains.

methods.name: PingPongForever
methods.description: Performs ping-pong interactions with another grain in an infinite loop.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all hosts and clients.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters cancel events.
